policy.target: min(maximum, (current headroom + retained unique blocks + metadata) / 2 - output reserve)
policy.ownership: Each allocation counted once across shared dependencies; distinct decoded allocations at the same file offset retain distinct accounting and lookup aliases.
policy.fairness: Statement/scoped managers share round-robin idle-root reclamation. Stable budget hooks cover direct result allocations and independent manager registries. Required growth preflights known budgets and synchronization wrappers. Reclamation nonblockingly acquires known deallocation paths and can reuse locks held by the same thread only for refundable frees. Busy caches/allocator paths are skipped; pins survive eviction. Region, monotonic and opaque free paths remain outside shared reclamation. All allocations remain under existing statement quotas.
policy.oversized_required_block: One required indivisible root may exceed the optional target. Other work can reclaim its cache reference; borrower pins remain valid.

failure_regression.previous: Two scheduled jobs: first parked, later job fails immediately. Ordered joins wait for the two-second safeguard and return Timeout instead of the injected failure.
failure_regression.current: Covering preparation/payload and raw ranges share completion notifications; later failure cancels and joins parked siblings before callback storage retires. The injected later failure is observed and all live callbacks return to zero.
oracles: Explicit caller cancellation retires all children and scheduling admission.
Existing real FS covering-directory wave and range fault tests pass.
Scoped deadline and authority checks preserve operational error identity.

native_drain_measurement.fixture: 8192 rows; eight 128-byte strings per row with independent ordinal/column tags. 64-row input cohorts interleave ascending ranks. Every sorted key and every value-column tag is checked in both policies.
native_drain_measurement.control: Same final implementation/binary with cache restricted to four roots and 64 KiB.
native_drain_measurement.candidate: Production adaptive byte-budgeted LRU with shared-body accounting and statement reclamation.
native_drain_measurement.timing_scope: Debug native thread CPU; setup, add and Sort.finish excluded. First leased-page advancement, complete drain and independent key/tag oracles included.
native_drain_measurement.sample_protocol: Functional comparisons provide one warmup per policy and codec; six alternating compressed-policy pairs follow. Task-owned compilation, tests and cleanup complete before timing; other host activity is uncontrolled.
native_drain_measurement.qualification: Uses available RAM for evictable residency: peak live bytes increase within the same limit. Spill writes remain identical. These are native spill byte counters and drain thread CPU, not cloud requests, archive throughput, HTTP latency, whole-publication throughput or peak RSS measurements.
